# Barlow Condensed

The typeface MultiLaps sets its figures and text in, by Jeremy Tribby and the Barlow Project
Authors. The Medium and SemiBold weights are bundled unmodified under `app/src/main/res/font/`
and are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `OFL.txt`. The same two weights
and Bold are also kept, unmodified and under the same licence, in
`docs/marketing/source/fonts/`, where the store graphics and marketing kit are drawn from.

Source: https://github.com/jpt/barlow
